claims.claim: Planner params with shell metacharacters arrive as literal argv elements — never through a shell
An action missing any must_capture artifact counts as not happened and no finding may reference it
Three egress violations stop the run with exit 1 (policy stop, distinct from the kill switch's 130)
A Sigma rule without an author is a hard error — DRL-1.1 attribution is enforced, not requested (both judge paths)
The detection_gap verdict fires only when all four formal conditions hold
Tampering with a chained record or an artifact file makes `hesper evidence verify` fail
Action cards without a full provenance triple fail registry lint — the CI gate catches them
vm-adapter parameters travel inside an uploaded JSON file, never on the command line
Empty allowlists deny every technique; a scope without adapters or targets refuses to load
pentest mode runs to budget exhaustion and still terminates gracefully (DONE, exit 0) with opportunistic findings
The MCP server completes an initialize → tools/list → tools/call round trip over stdio
The bundled lite lab comes up healthy (all containers) on this machine
A scripted validation run on the live lite lab produces at least one proven finding with a verified evidence chain
claims.command: go run ./cmd/hesper validate --scope schemas/v0/scope.manifest.example.json --scripted plans/lab-lite-demo.plan.json --run-dir /tmp/hesper-claim-l2 && go run ./cmd/hesper evidence verify /tmp/hesper-claim-l2
